notes.title: Resprite DA v1.27.0 Change log
notes.notes: [p]Hello everyone,[/p][p]This update brings new features, improved tools and shortcuts, and important fixes to make your workflow smoother and more reliable. [/p][p][/p][p]- Added: [b]Memo[/b] [b]window[/b], allowing you to add notes to files[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45192786/88dbd3eec7fc08db8c4502a03367f12a3d749c42.png"][/img][/p][p][b]- Added: Author Profile settings[/b][/p][p](Settings -> Author Profile. New files will automatically have author information added after enable this)[/p][p]- Added: [b]Sprite Info dialog[/b], allowing you to view file information, including creation time, edit time, etc.[/p][p](Menu -> Sprite -> Sprite Info)[/p][p][b]- Optimization: Scrollable color palette window[/b][/p][p][b]- Optimization: Added additional dither patterns[/b][/p][p]- Optimization: Bucket fill and Magic wand tools now support referencing all layers[/p][p](The "Ref All" checkbox in option bar)[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45192786/9c522fca6d84b2e5c10794067f513b08f1b58c13.png"][/img][/p][p]- Optimization: Added a shortcut for "Canvas Size" (C)[/p][p]- Optimization: Added a shortcut for toggling layer "Clipping Mask" (Ctrl+Alt+G)[/p][p]- Optimization: Added a shortcut for "Layer Properties" (F2)[/p][p]- Optimization: Added a shortcut for "Frame Properties" (P)[/p][p]- Optimization: Added a shortcut for "Delete Frame" (F6)[/p][p]- Optimization: Added a shortcut for "Toggle Layer Visibility" (Shift+X)[/p][p]- Improvement: Added a shortcut for "Expand/Collapse Layer Group" (Shift+E)[/p][p]- Improvement: Added a shortcut item for "Merge Layers Down"[/p][p](This doesn't have a default shortcut, but you can set one.)[/p][p]- Improvement: Added a shortcut for "Duplicate Layer" (Ctrl+J)[/p][p]- Improvement: Added a shortcut for "Save All" (Ctrl+Alt+S)[/p][p]- Improvement: Insert text dialog's parameters are now retained between sessions[/p][p]- Improvement: Previews of inserted text are now always displayed in their original proportions and support bidirectional scrolling[/p][p]- Improvement: New sprite, Sprite resize, and canvas resize dialog now support Enter to confirm[/p][p]- Improvement: Maintains the relative position of the Symmetry tool and content when resizing the canvas[/p][p]- Improvement: Restores the previous window position and size when opening the app on desktop[/p][p]- Improvement: When selecting a layer from the canvas, the timeline will scroll to the visible position of the layer[/p][p]- Improvement: Inserted text and images are now prioritized within the visible area of canvas[/p][p][b]- Improvement: Insert text to support character spacing, line spacing and vertical arrangement[/b][/p][p]- Changed: Slider bar value color now uses the button's pressed background color instead of the main panel background color[/p][p](This allows for differentiation even when the button background color matches the main panel background color)[/p][p]- Fix: Starting playback within a drawing tool session could cause unresponsiveness[/p][p]- Fix: Resolve some incorrect command strings[/p][p]- Fix: Addressed an issue where the interface could reset when disconnecting the keyboard on Android devices[/p][p]- Fix: Autosave could sometimes cause unresponsiveness when the timing conflicted with structural operations like deleting frames[/p][p]- Fix: Fixed the issue where the Insert Text dialog box could be opened via shortcut keys even when no file was open[/p][p][/p][p][/p][table equalcells="1" colwidth=""][tr][td][p]Switch to the beta branch to participate in testing. You can join our Discord to report bugs and submit feature requests. Thanks.[/p][/td][/tr][/table]

notes.title: Resprite DA v1.26.3 Change log
notes.notes:
Hello everyone, this update focuses on optimizing the drawing performance of large canvases (for example: 2000x2000), and also includes other optimizations and fixes. The specific contents are as follows:

- Added: Added Draw from Center option for Circle and Rectangle tools
- Added: ISO grid lines support multiple angles
- Added: Added shortcuts to switch between current tool and eraser
- Added: In toolbar settings, you can hide tools
- Optimization: Restructured rendering pipeline to improve drawing frame rate
- Optimization: Added historical color list to color pop-up window
- Optimization: Moved selection stroke color setting from canvas to other
- Optimization: Keep thumbnails when copying and pasting in the gallery
- Optimization: Added "Delete" menu item in Edit and improved trash icon
- Optimization: Added "Blending" option to all drawing tools
- Optimization: Improved file structure to increase file saving speed for large canvases
- Optimization: Tooltips are also displayed in sub-tool list in aggregate mode
- Optimization: Improved the display position of selection tool move buttons
- Optimization: Let users choose whether to delete semi-transparent colors when sampling to generate palette
- Optimization: You can sample and generate palette from reference image
- Optimization: Clipping mask can also be set in the layer properties dialog box
- Fix: Solve the problem that background content is brought in when inserting pictures and texts in the non-selection tool
- Fix: The problem that the ALT session is not restored after switching windows with ALT+TAB under Windows
- Fix: In the new sprite dialog box, sometimes the resolution selected on the left is inconsistent with the input box on the right
- Fix: When deleting a reference image, the reference image displayed in the canvas is not removed immediately
- Fix: When the canvas size exceeds the reference image size, the reference image displayed in the canvas does not fill the area after fitting
- Fix: When there are too many palette colors, the content below the palette interface in the color pop-up window overflows


Switch to the beta branch to participate in testing. You can join our Discord  to report bugs and submit feature requests. Thanks.

notes.title: Resprite DA v1.25.6-7 Change log
notes.notes: [p]Hello everyone, this is the change log of two small updates, which optimize some experience and fix some problems. The details are as follows:[/p][p][/p][p][/p][p][b]v1.25.7:[/b][/p][p]- Optimization: Improve canvas zooming steps[/p][p]- Optimization: Improve the scroll wheel zooming experience when the mouse cursor is outside the canvas[/p][p]- Optimization: Display the onion skin button of the timeline action bar by default[/p][p]- Optimization: Some single text input boxes can be confirmed directly after pressing Enter(Desktop)[/p][p]- Optimization: When some dialog boxes are opened, the text input box directly gets the focus(Desktop)[/p][p]- Fixed: Pressing the Ctrl key after switching windows in Windows sometimes opens the start menu incorrectly[/p][p]- Fixed: Solve the microscopic display error of pixels on the canvas caused by the Windows system display ratio of 125% etc.[/p][p]- Fixed: Unresponsive issue when exporting super large images (~20k)[/p][p]- Fixed: Delete extra spaces at the end of the image name when importing images[/p][p]- Fixed: Wrong default row width when sampling and generating palette[/p][p]- Fixed: The process of sampling the palette from the image cannot be interrupted[/p][p][/p][p][/p][p][b]v1.25.6:[/b][/p][p]- Added: Can set the max undo steps[/p][p]- Optimization: Thepreview window of desktop version also displays the zoom level[/p][p]- Fix: Solve the abnormal behavior of the ALT key in Windows 11 system[/p][p][/p][p][/p][p]You can join our Discord  to report bugs and submit feature requests. notes.title: Resprite DA v1.25 change log
notes.notes: [p]Hello everyone, this version (v1.25) optimizes and solves all the serious problems found in the internal test, and is ready for the official release. The specific contents of the update are as follows:[/p][p][/p][p]- New: Support setting actions for the Ctrl key[/p][p]- Optimization: Display the theme list alphabetically[/p][p]- Optimization: Add two preset themes[/p][p]- Optimization: When moving selection, hold down shift to allow only horizontal or vertical movement[/p][p]- Optimization: When using the move tool, hold down shift to allow only horizontal or vertical movement[/p][p]- Optimization: When using the line tool, hold down shift to enable angle snapping[/p][p]- Optimization: When using the ellipse, rectangle tool, or marquee selection, hold down shift to draw a circle or square[/p][p]- Optimization: Added crash information collection and reporting[/p][p]- Optimization: Added corresponding shortcut keys for some menu items[/p][p]- Optimization: Improve shortcut key settings and warn about duplicate shortcut keys[/p][p]- Optimization: Added special cursors for fill tool and gradient tool[/p][p]- Optimization: Improve the interface of the insert text window[/p][p]- Optimization: Improve multiple user experience details[/p][p]- Fixed: Some devices crash when opening the export dialog[/p][p]- Fixed: Switching the frame range option in exporting video dialog does not refresh the video duration[/p][p]- Fixed: When modifying shortcut keys, inputting duplicate keys will cause errors[/p][p]- Fixed: Cannot switch input box focus via Tab[/p][p]- Fixed: Pressing the spacebar to pan the canvas will draw the background into the selection[/p][p]- Fixed: The issue where Alt and Ctrl key operations interfere with brush preview, combination shortcut keys, etc.[/p][p]- Fixed: Select layer tool should ignore the effects of symmetry tool[/p][p]- Fixed: Alt key will cause focus error in Windows system[/p][p][/p][p]Thanks for reading. You can report bugs and feature requests to us through Discord or other channels. Thank you.[/p]

notes.title: Resprite v1.24 change log
notes.notes:
Hello everyone, starting from this internal beta version v1.24, we have started to publish update records in the community of the Steam store. The first public release will be coming soon. Let's take a look at what has changed.

Resprite DA v1.24 Change log:

- Added: Can export video[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45192786/26be62ad5b13a35ac3651809bf4edc224c7cd90e.png[/img]
- Added: Add canvas fit center menu item and shortcut
- Added: Add reset symmetry tool center button on action bar[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45192786/7d098fbb761c9d5fd7d407d958567a8ac95b1a51.png[/img]
- Optimization: Add shortcut keys for Delete and Backspace keys to delete content
- Optimization: Add a right-click menu on the colors of the palette
- Optimization: When exporting in layers, add the option to remove the layer number in file name
- Optimization: Use the system clipboard to paste content across software
- Optimization: Display marks for some layer blending modes that are not yet supported
- Optimization: Optimize and add some translation strings
- Optimization: Support moving and zooming the canvas with Mac's TrackPad
- Optimization: Update the cheatsheet content
- Optimization: Remove the shadow background of the layer properties, adjust color, and outline dialog boxes
- Optimization: Change to a separate shortcut key configuration window and optimize the shortcut key setting interface
- Optimization: Can set selection stroke color[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45192786/f74763064da0d1ac61adb6c84fb03a37f588cf23.png[/img]
- Optimization: Shortcut keys such as adjusting brush size and moving selected content with arrow keys support repeat triggering
- Optimization: Optimize the blink timing when selecting a layer
- Optimization: Capture and report exception stack
- Fixed: The desktop version cannot read images from the file path of the system clipboard
- Fixed: Transparent areas turned black when pasting images from the system clipboard in Windows
- Fixed: Some shortcut keys not working when using text input box
- Fixed: The issue where the command session was not canceled when clicking the close button in the color adjustment dialog box
- Fixed: The Apply button in the color adjustment dialog box sometimes has the wrong state
- Fixed: The issue where the long press gesture to select a layer did not work
- Fixed: When transforming a selection, panning the canvas causes background content to be included in the selection
- Fixed: Fill bucket tool's Ignore color option no longer affects Magic Wand and Gradient tool
- Fixed: When importing ase files in indexed color mode, an error message will be prompted instead of crashing
- Fixed: Crash when using the move button in the selection tool when there is no selection
